summary: Tested Amazon tag conversion (skips Sankmo), cleaning of other people's tracking links (Amazon/Flipkart/wrapped dl= links), bulk convert (max 5, skipped list, message rewrite, title/image/price via pricehistory), image proxy, retag of existing Amazon deals on tag save, Admin Convert Links + Affiliate Setup tabs, and Deal card copy/share buttons. All requested features work. 12/13 backend tests pass; the one failure is a minor 500 from image-proxy for an unreachable host. Frontend flows all worked with no page errors. amazon_tag was set back to '' at the end, and the test deal was deleted.

minor.issue: If the host can't be reached or times out, the call returns 500 instead of 400. httpx.ConnectError/TimeoutException is not caught (server.py image_proxy). Wrap the request in try/except and raise HTTPException(400).
SSRF risk: it fetches any http(s) URL, including internal/private hosts. Consider blocking private IP ranges or localhost.

Amazon items often come back with title/image/price null (e.g. B09B8X9RGM): pricehistory has no data and Amazon blocks og:image. Flipkart and some Amazon ASINs do get filled in. Acceptable, but the card then has no image to share.

Pre-existing: when the manual price is under 30% of the pricehistory reference, the price is replaced but discount is not recalculated. Example: price 499 / MRP 59900 is shown as ₹49,900 with '99% OFF'.

issues: The action row (Grab Deal + chart + copy + share + Post) is too crowded now that the share button was added. 'Grab Deal' wraps onto 2 lines, and the 'Post' button overflows or gets clipped at the card's right edge (seen on the 4th card). Use icon-only Post, a smaller gap, or move the secondary icons to a second row.
Image thumbnail is lazy/slow, so it shows briefly as an empty grey box. Minor.

action_items: Catch httpx errors in /api/image-proxy and return 400 (currently 500 for unreachable hosts)
Fix the crowded or overflowing action-button row on DealCard in the 4-column desktop grid
Optional: block private/internal hosts in image-proxy (SSRF)
Optional: recalculate discount in enrich() when the price is replaced
critical_code_review_comments: strip_affiliate rewrites every Amazon domain (amazon.com too) to amazon.in/dp/ASIN. This is fine for an Indian audience but changes the store for amazon.com links.
convert_bulk uses message.replace(orig, out). If one link is a prefix of another link in the same message, the replacement could corrupt it. Rare, but a regex replace with boundaries would be safer.
retag_amazon accesses d['clean_url'] directly. A legacy Amazon deal without clean_url would raise KeyError and break PUT /settings. Use d.get('clean_url') or d['url'].
server.py is about 896 lines; consider splitting it into routers.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ deals temporarily and deleted them. amazon_tag reset to ''.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sankmo/Telegram are not configured in preview, so non-Amazon links come back cleaned with an error message (expected). Run the regression suite: pytest backend/tests/test_iteration11_amazon_bulk_share.py (it resets amazon_tag to '' on teardown). In headless Chromium with clipboard permissions, copy/share fall back to ClipboardItem and show the toast 'Image + deal text copied'.
